verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser documents serving employer clients at scale, including hospital systems, large manufacturers and multinational companies, and offers employer-side I-9/E-Verify compliance. That implies it can handle multiple sponsored cases for one organization. However, its startups practice is framed around founders and entrepreneurs, and nothing in the evidence describes multi-case management for a client or a scale-up hiring program. missing for 10: documented multi-case or portfolio management for an employer's team, a stated startup/scale-up sponsorship program beyond founder cases, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, I can run visas for a growing team through one provider — multi-case management or a stated startup/scale-up program beyond single founder cases

citations.quote: Our business clients include hospital systems, large manufacturers, multi-national companies, mid-size family-owned businesses, tech companies, and entrepreneurial start-ups.
